'''U-3PO''', also known as '''Yoo-Threepio''', was a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] created by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. U-3PO served in the [[Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Diplomatic Corps]] of the [[House of Organa/Legends|Royal House of Alderaan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], but eventually became a unwitting [[Sleeper agent/Legends|sleeper agent]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
[[File:U-3PO.jpg|thumb|left|150px|U-3PO on ''Tantive IV''.]]
During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], U-3PO was reprogrammed to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], making the droid a unwitting [[Sleeper agent/Legends|sleeper agent]]. U-3PO was inserted into the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]{{'s}} droid pool during the [[subjugation of Ralltiir]]. U-3PO later transmitted an [[Simu-tunnel/Legends|S-thread]] signal to the Empire, allowing the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] to track down the ''Tantive IV'', thus allowing it to be attacked by the ''Devastator'' and boarded by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="VG3" /> As Vader's forces boarded the ''Tantive IV'', U-3PO walked behind [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] as the two droids discussed the imminent attack on the vessel. Shortly after, U-3PO turned into an adjacent doorway.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
U-3PO had [[Color/Legends|silver]] plating and yellow [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
U-3PO first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] (initially known just as "''Star Wars"'') as a background character in the opening scene aboard the ''Tantive IV''. The droid was first identified by name in the [[1995]] ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game by Decipher Inc. The card's flavor text stated that the droid was a double agent for the Galactic Empire. The existence of a double agent aboard the ''Tantive'' had first been alluded to in the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio]] episode "[[Black Knight, White Princess, and Pawns]]." In that episode, Captain Antilles surmises that some spy must have helped the Empire pursue their starship to Tatooine.<ref name="Black Knight>{{SWRadio|Black Knight, White Princess, and Pawns}}</ref>
